description: This file defines a controller class 'ViewMyDetailsController' within the OrangeHRM PIM module. It handles user requests to view their personal details by redirecting to the appropriate URL based on the authenticated user's employee number.

classes.name: ViewMyDetailsController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for handling user requests to view their personal details by redirecting to the appropriate page based on logged-in user's employee number.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the request to view personal details, fetches the authenticated user's employee number, and redirects to the personal details view URL.
